sources.label: Deterministic sorting and reduced promotional noise for talabat on ARM64
sources.author: Consumer Clarity
patch_list: Clears Android's secure-window flag so screenshots and screen recording are allowed.
Blocks file URLs from reading other files or making cross-origin requests in WebView pages.
Blocks cross-site cookies inside Talabat's in-app WebView pages.
Prevents in-app WebView pages from opening Android content URLs.
Prevents in-app WebView pages from reading arbitrary file URLs.
Blocks insecure HTTP content from loading inside HTTPS WebView pages.
Reduces WebView data usage by blocking network-loaded images.
Prevents WebView JavaScript from opening additional windows automatically.
Sorts restaurants by organic placement, rating and ID, and reviews by date and ID. Requires Talabat 14.4.0 (2368) on ARM64.
Disables Adjust's install-referrer receiver without changing normal deep links.
Disables Google Analytics measurement upload services and its receiver.
Removes background-location access. Foreground delivery addresses and order tracking can still work.
Removes Bluetooth scan, connect, advertise, and legacy Bluetooth permissions.
Disables Braze's push receiver. Talabat's separate Firebase order-messaging service is unchanged.
Removes camera permission. QR scanning, document capture, and profile-photo capture will be unavailable.
Disables the receiver that reacts to country-boundary location changes.
Disables Firebase's session lifecycle reporting service. Crash and analytics controls remain separate.
Disables the Tag Manager background service used for marketing measurement.
Disables Google's background telemetry upload scheduler and alarm receivers.
Removes access to high-sampling-rate motion sensors used by diagnostics and gesture detection.
Removes Huawei's advertising-identifier service declaration while leaving Huawei login and maps intact.
Removes legacy broad external-storage read and write permissions. App-owned media sharing remains separate.
Removes microphone permission and prevents in-app audio recording.
Skips the pairip license check and its repeated scheduler so the modified app can start without Google Play licensing. Other Google-dependent features are unchanged.
Removes Android's screen-capture detection permission. This does not prevent Android screenshots.
Sets Sentry's ANR profiling sample rate to zero.
Prevents Sentry from attaching thread dumps to ANR reports.
Disables automatic startup and activity lifecycle performance traces.
Prevents application-supplied breadcrumbs from being recorded by Sentry.
Disables Sentry performance traces for cache operations.
Suppresses Sentry events, exceptions, messages, and user-feedback reports while returning an empty event ID.
Prevents Sentry from attaching screenshots to crash events.
Disables Sentry performance traces for database transactions.
Prevents Sentry from collecting additional device context.
Disables Sentry replay capture associated with errors.
Disables Sentry frame-rate and rendering performance collection.
Disables Sentry reports for historical application-not-responding events.
Prevents taps and other user interactions from becoming Sentry breadcrumbs.
Disables Sentry performance traces built from user interactions.
Disables activity, application, and component lifecycle breadcrumbs.
Prevents Sentry from turning logcat messages into breadcrumbs or Sentry logs. Logcat output itself is unchanged.
Disables Sentry's native crash-handler preload provider.
Prevents network changes from becoming Sentry breadcrumbs.
Sets Sentry's performance trace sample rate to zero.
Disables Sentry's second-generation automatic performance collection.
Sets Sentry's profiling sample rate to zero.
Disables Sentry performance traces for queue operations.
Prevents Sentry from attaching raw native tombstone data.
Prevents Sentry replay from capturing network request and response bodies.
Disables Sentry's root-status checks and reporting.
Displays no Sentry session-replay capture. This is separate from crash screenshots.
Disables Sentry's automatic startup performance provider.
Prevents Sentry from collecting external-storage context.
Prevents Sentry replay from capturing SurfaceView content.
Disables system-event breadcrumbs and their extra device details.
Disables Sentry tombstone collection and historical tombstone reporting.
Prevents Sentry from attaching the app's view hierarchy to events.
Prevents Shake Bugs from recording lifecycle and touch activity.
Prevents application log messages from being added to Shake Bugs reports.
Suppresses Shake Bugs error handling, silent reports, and crash-report enablement.
Prevents Shake Bugs from receiving user IDs, metadata, and push tokens.
Prevents Shake Bugs from starting. Other Shake Bugs switches are unnecessary when this is selected.
Prevents Shake Bugs from recording network requests and responses.
Prevents Shake Bugs from recording notification events.
Disables Shake Bugs' foreground screen-recording service.
Removes Talabat's ability to draw over other apps.
Prevents in-app WebView pages from continuing audio in the background.
Disables WebView caching to reduce retained browsing data. Network usage may increase.
Disables the legacy WebView database API and its stored data.
Disables WebView DOM storage. Some signed-in WebView pages may lose local state.
Prevents in-app WebView pages from saving form data.
Prevents in-app WebView pages from requesting device location through the browser API.
Requests Android Safe Browsing checks for in-app WebView pages.
Requests dark rendering for supported in-app WebView pages. Flutter screens are unchanged.
Prevents Braze promotional in-app messages from being queued or displayed. Functional app dialogs and push notifications are unchanged.
Prevents Shake Bugs from displaying support-chat notifications.
Prevents Shake Bugs from opening its feedback and bug-report interface.
Adds a draggable Clarity button to Talabat's home screen for direct access to the patch control center.
Keeps the screen awake while Talabat's main activity is visible.
Shows the destination before opening a link, with Open, Share, Copy, and Cancel actions.
Routes links that would open in Talabat's in-app WebView to the default browser. Can be toggled in Consumer Clarity settings.
Adds System Default, English, Arabic, and Kurdish language choices for Talabat's interface.
Disables confirmed Firebase, Adjust, Perseus and Braze event logging paths without blocking restaurant, checkout or order-tracking network requests.
Removes access to Android Privacy Sandbox attribution reporting.
Removes access to Android Privacy Sandbox advertising identifiers.
Removes Android's advertising-identifier permission. Talabat can no longer request the Google advertising ID.
Prevents in-app WebView media from starting without a user gesture. Manual playback remains available.
Adds a minimum-rating filter for restaurant listings, including 4.0 and 4.5 stars.
Adds minimum-rating and reviews-with-text filters without changing review content.
Adds JSON export and import for patch preferences without account or order data.
Adds a search field to filter patch controls by name, description, or category.
Opens Android's share sheet for links instead of displaying them in Talabat's WebView.
Adds independent text scaling from 85% to 130% without changing device-wide font settings.
Requests private browsing behavior for in-app WebView pages. Signed-in pages may stop working.
